preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the graph adjacency list must equal the number of nodes n.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(edges, list) and all(1 <= v <= n for v in edges) for edges in graph)
preconditions.description: Each node's adjacency list must contain valid node indices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of pairs of nodes at even distance.
